pages.about:
Welcome to NOW (Nonveg On Wheel)

Freshness is not just a promise—it's our commitment.

NOW (Nonveg On Wheel) is dedicated to delivering fresh, hygienically prepared chicken and mutton directly to your doorstep. Every order is carefully handled, quality checked, and packed to maintain freshness and taste.

We believe customers deserve premium quality, transparent pricing, and reliable delivery every time they order.

Why Choose NOW?
✅ Freshly Prepared Products
✅ Hygienic Processing & Packaging
✅ Fast & Reliable Delivery
✅ Quality Checked Before Dispatch
✅ Secure Payments
✅ Dedicated Customer Support

NOW – Fresh • Fast • Trusted
pages.safety: Food safety is non-negotiable at NOW. Every item that reaches your home goes through a strict quality and hygiene process. We work with licensed suppliers, maintain cold chain, use food-grade packaging, and offer a 2-hour replacement guarantee if anything is wrong.
pages.privacy:
Your privacy matters to us.

NOW collects only the information required to provide better service.

Information collected may include:
• Name
• Mobile Number
• Delivery Address
• Live Location (only during delivery)
• Order History
• Payment Details (processed securely)

We never sell customer information to third parties.

Your data is used only for:
• Order processing
• Delivery
• Customer support
• Service improvement
• Promotional offers (optional)

We use appropriate security practices to protect your personal information.
pages.terms:
By using NOW, you agree to the following terms:

• Customers must provide accurate delivery details.
• Orders are subject to product availability.
• Fresh products are prepared only after order confirmation.
• Prices, offers, and promotions may change without prior notice.
• Delivery time shown is an estimate and may vary due to traffic, weather, or operational conditions.
• Customers should inspect their order at the time of delivery and report any issue promptly.
• Fraudulent activities, misuse of offers, repeated fake orders, or abusive behaviour may result in account suspension or permanent blocking.
• NOW reserves the right to cancel or refuse any order in exceptional circumstances.
• By placing an order, customers confirm that they have read and accepted all applicable policies of NOW.
pages.refund:
At NOW, every order is freshly prepared after confirmation. Therefore, refunds are available only in genuine cases.

✅ Eligible for Refund or Replacement

Refund or replacement may be approved if:
• Wrong product is delivered.
• Product is damaged or leaking during delivery.
• Product quality issue is verified by NOW.
• Order is cancelled by NOW before delivery.
• Item is missing from the order.

❌ Refund Will NOT Be Provided If

• Customer changes their mind after order confirmation.
• Wrong delivery address or phone number is provided.
• Customer is unavailable during delivery.
• Product has already been consumed or partially used.
• Customer refuses delivery without a valid reason.
• Minor delays caused by traffic, weather, festivals, or unforeseen circumstances.
• Personal taste preferences after consuming the product.

⚠️ Important

Any quality issue must be reported within 30 minutes of delivery with clear photos or videos.
NOW reserves the right to verify every claim before approving any refund or replacement.
Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method or NOW Wallet within the applicable processing time.
pages.delivery:
NOW currently delivers only within serviceable areas.

Delivery charges and estimated delivery time are calculated automatically based on your delivery location.

Estimated delivery times may vary due to:
• Traffic
• Weather
• High order volume
• Festivals
• Operational conditions

Delivery will be attempted at the address provided by the customer.

If the customer is unavailable or cannot be contacted after reasonable attempts, the order may be cancelled without refund for freshly prepared products.
pages.membership:
NOW Membership provides extra convenience and exclusive benefits.

Membership may include:
• Reduced delivery charges
• Priority order processing
• Exclusive member offers
• Special rewards

Please Note

• Benefits are available only in eligible delivery zones.
• Membership benefits are non-transferable.
• Membership fee is non-refundable except where required by applicable law.
• Unused benefits expire according to the membership plan.
• NOW reserves the right to update membership pricing and benefits.
pages.faq:
How do I place an order?
Login, select products, choose your delivery address, complete payment or choose Cash on Delivery, and place your order.

Which products are available?
Fresh Chicken and Fresh Mutton.

Can I cancel my order?
Orders may be cancelled only before preparation begins. Once preparation has started, cancellation may not be possible because products are prepared fresh.

How do I track my order?
Track your order live from the Order Tracking section in the app.

Which payment methods are supported?
Cash on Delivery, UPI, Debit/Credit Cards, Wallet and other supported payment methods.

How can I contact customer support?
Through the Support section available inside the app.
